columns.Name: Name
columns.Event: The lifts competed in.  SBD is the standard three powerlifts, but competitors may do only some of the lifts depending on the competition.  If someone competed in the BD event (Bench Deadlift), they would not have any squat data but would not be Disqualified because they are not competing in the Squat.
columns.Equipment: The type of equipment that was worn.  Federations may break competition down by different equipment classes. Examples: Raw (No equipment), Wraps (Knee Wraps worn), Single Ply (Single layer of supportive equipment) and Multi Ply (Multiple layers of supportive equipment)
columns.Age: The age of the lifter in Years
columns.AgeClass: The age class in which the lifter competed.  Federations may break competition down by different age groups.
columns.WeightClassKg: The weight class in which the lifter competed. Federations may break competition down by different weight classes.  The lifter's bodyweight may not exceed this number at the time of weighing in.
columns.Squat1Kg: The lifter's first squat attempt in kilograms.  Negative means the attempt was failed.  Ignore NaN
columns.Squat2Kg: The lifter's second squat attempt in kilograms.  Negative means the attempt was failed.  Ignore NaN
columns.Squat3Kg: The lifter's third squat attempt in kilograms.  Negative means the attempt was failed.  Ignore NaN
columns.Squat4Kg: The lifter's fourth squat attempt in kilograms.  Negative means the attempt was failed.  Ignore NaN. Not commonly used, only for record attempts.
columns.Best3SquatKg: The best squat of [Squat1Kg, Squat2Kg, Squat3Kg].  This value will count towards TotalKg
columns.Bench1Kg: The lifter's first bench attempt in kilograms.  Negative means the attempt was failed.  Ignore NaN
columns.Bench2Kg: The lifter's second bench attempt in kilograms.  Negative means the attempt was failed.  Ignore NaN
columns.Bench3Kg: The lifter's third bench attempt in kilograms.  Negative means the attempt was failed.  Ignore NaN
columns.Bench4Kg: The lifter's fourth bench attempt in kilograms.  Negative means the attempt was failed.  Ignore NaN. Not commonly used, only for record attempts.
columns.Best3BenchKg: The best squat of [Bench1Kg, Bench2Kg, Bench3Kg].  This value will count towards TotalKg
columns.Deadlift1Kg: The lifter's first deadlift attempt in kilograms.  Negative means the attempt was failed.  Ignore NaN
columns.Deadlift2Kg: The lifter's second deadlift attempt in kilograms.  Negative means the attempt was failed.  Ignore NaN
columns.Deadlift3Kg: The lifter's third deadlift attempt in kilograms.  Negative means the attempt was failed.  Ignore NaN
columns.Deadlift4Kg: The lifter's fourth deadlift attempt in kilograms.  Negative means the attempt was failed.  Ignore NaN. Not commonly used, only for record attempts.
columns.Best3DeadliftKg: The best squat of [Deadlift1Kg, Deadlift2Kg, Deadlift3Kg].  This value will count towards TotalKg
columns.TotalKg: The sum of Best3SquatKg, Best3BenchKg, Best3DeadliftKg
columns.Wilks: Wilks points, often used as a Best Lifter formula. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wilks_Coefficient
columns.Glossbrenner: Glossbrenner points, another formula often used as a Best Lifter formula.
columns.Federation: Powerlifting Federation the meet was hosted by
